products.name: Custom Ambient Lighting — Any Car
products.summary: App-controlled RGB or single-colour ambient lighting, designed, supplied and installed for any make and model.
products.description: Custom interior ambient lighting for any make and model — ute, sedan, SUV or hatch. We plan the layout around your interior (door trims, footwells, dash and centre console), then supply, wire and install it so it looks factory. Choose full RGB with app control and music modes, or a single colour to match your interior. Price depends on your car and the number of zones, so tell us your car for an exact quote.
